// channels: receive and send against a buffered channel a binding
// hands out. The ok of the two-value receive is implicit: a closed
// channel ends the program with io.EOF, and the execution context
// arms every blocking operation.
c := chanOf("a", "b");
v := <-c;
assert.Equal(tb, "a", v);

w := <-c;
assert.Equal(tb, "b", w);

c <- "sent";
r := <-c;
assert.Equal(tb, "sent", r);

var d chan string;
d = chanOf("typed");
s := <-d;
assert.Equal(tb, "typed", s);
